title: Nervous about your first class?
headline: Nervous about your first class?
caption:
Thinking about trying the reformer, but not sure what to expect? Here's what your first class at POWR looks like. 🙂

We'll welcome you in and show you to your reformer. No one expects you to know how it works.

We start slowly, with simple moves, and show you how to set the springs and straps as we go.

Every exercise has an easier and a harder option, so you work at your level. Lots of people come on their own, men and women, and nobody is watching you.

Just wear something comfy you can move in.

If you'd like to build up gently, Reformer Foundations is 3 classes for £45.

Book your first reformer Pilates class in Clitheroe through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
